name: Art
description: Create and edit images or generate short videos with Cindy's media capabilities. You can also invoke it directly with $cindy-art.
whenToUse: Use this plugin to create images, illustrations, avatars, posters, or other artwork; edit a generated image by adding elements or changing its style; generate a short video; or animate a still image.

gen_image.description: Generate one image from a text prompt and return an image URL that can be rendered in chat.

edit_image.description: Edit, redraw, stylize, or combine up to four source images. For images previously created by this plugin, pass the cindy-media:// URLs returned by gen_image or edit_image in images. For images attached by the user, put their xdt-image:// URLs in the top-level attachments field of ghost_call so the host can transfer them; do not also put them in images.

gen_video.description: Generate a short video from a text prompt. This can take several minutes. Returns a video URL that can be rendered in chat.

edit_video.description: Generate a video from reference images: one image animates the first frame, while two images create a first-to-last-frame transition. For images created by this plugin, pass their cindy-media:// URLs in images. For user attachments, put them in the top-level attachments field of ghost_call so the host can transfer them.
